pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0138 unified Graph Debug
pr_body:
## Summary

- replace the fixed Play-mode Behavior Tree tab with a target-aware Graph Debug shell
- preserve actual Behavior Tree runtime evidence and add actual Animation Controller graph/state/transition/motion-resolution evidence
- prefer open graph working copies, suppress stale overlays, and keep Graph Debug read-only
- highlight active Animation transitions on the shared Graph Canvas and simplify Animation Graph Add Node presentation

## Validation

Run the repository Windows Validation workflow and required visual validation for the changed Editor UI.
